notes.title: Update March 17
notes.notes:
Fix - Starting Dragon
Previously, the dragon was essentially immortal.
And the players did not understand that they could not defeat him.
Now the dragon can be killed, but this will not affect the further plot.

notes.title: Switching to the free version.
notes.notes:
Switching to the free version.

When I started making this game, I did not pursue the goal of making money on it, but I wanted my work to pay off.
That didn't happen so I want to move the game to a free-to-play basis.
After all, why do you need a game if you don't play it?
In a week I will apply for transferring the game to a free basis.
I already wanted to make it free a year ago, but then the support dissuaded me.
Now I have firmly decided to make it free and available to everyone.
Thanks to all those who have already purchased this game and went through it.
I hope you liked this story.

notes.title: Very first update
notes.notes:
After 2 years, we released an update in which we corrected small errors.
We were asked to add achievements and we did it.
We changed the theme in the main menu.
And many more small fixes
